description: Returns a published wedding venue by its slug, including photos, highlights, travel information, planning estimates and available sourced facts with provenance, with each price also given as numbers, its currency and what it is per. Cost estimates are the ones the venue page shows, so a response gives one price for the venue and names any older estimate it left out. An estimators block names the destination the budget and guest travel estimators accept for the venue, the country when its area has no budget row, and covered destinations in the same country when travel has no figures for its area. When a slug is not a published venue, the result says whether it was never listed or was taken down, and suggests published venues: by name for a slug that does not exist, or the listing of the same name and the closest venues for one taken down. Estimates are not supplier quotes or live availability.

slug.description: Unique slug identifying a published Aisle venue.
